name: FPB-RA4E2
description: Cheap $11 Fast Prototyping Board for the RA4E2 (100 MHz Cortex-M33): built-in J-Link OB debugger, Arduino Uno and Pmod headers, and through-holes to every MCU pin.
notes: R7FA4E2B93CFM (LQFP-64, 128 KB flash, 40 KB RAM). Renesas lists $11.14 as a budgetary price.
USB connector type, LED/button set, board size and GPIO count were not given on Renesas' page and are estimates.
